mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has risen consistently from -34.4% (t-3w) to -29.1% (t-0w), a 5.3-point improvement. This sustained recovery in commuting infrastructure signals resumption of work-linked mobility patterns that will drive retail footfall upward over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 5.3 points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days is not higher than the mean over the last 28 days, or TRANSIT reverses to below -30% in any of the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated at +9.4%, indicating sustained home-based activity. When RESIDENTIAL stays above +8%, consumers defer discretionary retail visits, suppressing RETAIL_REC growth. This behavioral lock-in will persist over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL drops below +5% within one week and RETAIL_REC rises by more than 5 points in the following two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility declined sharply from -16.0% (t-2w) to -23.0% (t-1w), then recovered to -15.3% (t-0w). This volatility in outdoor recreation signals uncertainty in leisure behavior. When PARKS volatility exceeds 7 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC is below -24%, retail recovery is suppressed for the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS week-on-week swing exceeds 7 points and RETAIL_REC below -24%
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS swing of 7.7 points from t-2w to t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -20% in the week following a PARKS volatility spike, or PARKS stabilizes within a 3-point band for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has remained stable and near-baseline (range -6.0% to -3.4%), indicating essential services remain accessible. When essential services show minimal disruption, consumers gain confidence to increase discretionary retail visits. This confidence effect will drive RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM variance is 2.6 points over four weeks
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM drops below -10% in any week over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not exceed -20% on average over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has improved from -23.4% (t-3w) to -19.1% (t-0w), a 4.3-point gain. Simultaneously, RETAIL_REC has improved from -26.4% to -23.7%. When both series move in tandem with positive slope, workplace return drives retail recovery. This co-movement will accelerate RETAIL_REC gains over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and RETAIL_REC both improve week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:both series improved over four-week window
failure_condition: WORKPLACES declines by more than 2 points in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC fails to improve by at least 2 points on average over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility at -15.3% (t-0w) is elevated relative to RETAIL_REC at -23.7%, suggesting outdoor leisure is recovering faster than indoor retail. This seasonal shift toward outdoor activity will continue to suppress indoor RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as consumers substitute outdoor for retail venues.
candidate_trigger: PARKS mobility exceeds RETAIL_REC mobility by more than 8 points
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -15.3% vs RETAIL_REC at -23.7%, gap of 8.4 points
failure_condition: PARKS and RETAIL_REC converge to within 3 points of each other, or RETAIL_REC rises above -18% while PARKS remains below -10%.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility at -29.1% (t-0w) remains severely depressed. When transit access is constrained below -28%, consumers cannot reach retail venues efficiently, creating a hard ceiling on RETAIL_REC recovery. This constraint will keep RETAIL_REC below -22% over the next week.
failure_condition: TRANSIT improves to above -25% within one week and RETAIL_REC simultaneously rises above -20%, or RETAIL_REC exceeds -20% while TRANSIT remains below -28%.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility at +9.4% combined with WORKPLACES at -19.1% creates a 28.5-point gap, indicating strong home-bias behavior. When this gap exceeds 25 points, consumers prioritize home-based activities over retail. This behavioral regime will suppress RETAIL_REC for the next two weeks unless the gap narrows.
failure_condition: The RESIDENTIAL-WORKPLACES gap narrows to below 20 points within one week, or RETAIL_REC rises by more than 3 points in the following two weeks despite the gap remaining above 25 points.
